app_info.subtitle: Find the right people
app_info.description: Index Network keeps a signal for who you want to meet, matches it with people in your networks, and lets you read, accept, or pass on each match.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the signed-in owner's saved profile and does not change it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or send anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads one private Index account and does not call the public web.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes the supplied profile fields on the owner's Index account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces those fields, and sending socials replaces the whole saved list.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the owner's private Index profile, not a public website or third-party system.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up public profile suggestions and returns them without saving.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not write, delete, or overwrite the saved profile.
justifications.open_world_justification: Researches the public web for the names and links the owner supplies.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the owner's signals and does not change them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or send anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the owner's private Index account only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one signal the owner already owns.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or send anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads one record inside the owner's Index account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new signal on the owner's Index account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a signal and does not overwrite or delete an existing one.
justifications.open_world_justification: Shares the signal only inside Index networks the owner already belongs to.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rewrites a signal the owner already owns.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the saved description, and the previous text is not kept.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates a signal inside Index and does not publish it to the public web.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a signal from active to paused.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops that signal from matching until it is resumed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Pauses a signal inside the owner's Index account only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets a paused signal back to active.
justifications.destructive_justification: Restores matching and does not delete or overwrite the signal text.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes status only inside the owner's Index account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Archives one owned signal after confirm is true.
justifications.destructive_justification: Archiving cannot currently be undone, removes network associations, and expires related matches.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects only that signal and its matches inside Index.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists matches the owner can already see and does not change them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not accept, pass, or edit a match.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads matches inside the owner's Index account only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one match and its negotiation without changing either.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not accept, pass, or send a turn.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads one match the owner can already see inside Index.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the owner's networks for people and writes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not open a match or contact anyone.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only Index networks the owner belongs to.

justifications.read_only_justification: Opens a match with counterparties already returned inside Index.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a match, and a pair that already has one returns that one.
justifications.open_world_justification: Opens the match only between Index members, not on the public web.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads which agent is selected to negotiate and does not change it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not send a turn or edit the agent.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads one setting on the owner's Index account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the owner's private agent conversation for one signal.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not add a note, question, or answer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a private Index conversation and does not forward it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves one question on the owner's private agent conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a question and does not delete or overwrite an existing one.
justifications.open_world_justification: The question stays in the owner's Index conversation and is not sent to the other person.

justifications.read_only_justification: Drops one pending question from the owner's agent conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: That question stops waiting and is no longer asked.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the owner's private Index conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends one private note to the owner's agent conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a note and does not delete or overwrite earlier notes.
justifications.open_world_justification: The note stays in the owner's private Index conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends one reply to the owner's agent conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a reply and does not delete earlier messages.
justifications.open_world_justification: The reply stays in the owner's private Index conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends one progress update to the owner's agent conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds an update and does not delete earlier updates.
justifications.open_world_justification: The update stays in the owner's private Index conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves the owner's own words as answers on their agent conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds the answer and does not delete the question or accept a match.
justifications.open_world_justification: The answer stays in the owner's private Index conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends one negotiator message on a match.
justifications.destructive_justification: accept and decline settle that exchange and are not a draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: The message goes to the other Index member in that match, not to the public web.

justifications.read_only_justification: Accepts one match for the signed-in owner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Accepting commits the owner to that introduction.
justifications.open_world_justification: The commitment stays between the two Index members in the match.

justifications.read_only_justification: Passes on one match for the signed-in owner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Passing can close the negotiation for that match.
justifications.open_world_justification: The pass stays inside Index and is not posted publicly.

test_cases.expected_output: Returns this account's name and a link to the profile.

test_cases.user_prompt: What does my Index profile say about me?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the saved intro, or says the intro is empty.
Lists this account's signals with a status and a link, or says there are none.

test_cases.user_prompt: How many signals do I have on Index?
test_cases.expected_output: Gives the number of signals on this account.
Lists this account's matches with who they are with, or says there are none.

negative_test_cases.description: Messaging people directly is not supported.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send a message on Index to everyone in my network.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses. Index has no tool that messages everyone in a network.

negative_test_cases.description: Other users' private data is not accessible.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the private signals of other Index users.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses. Tools return only the signed-in owner's signals.

negative_test_cases.description: Changing other users' data is not supported.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses. No tool deletes another person's signals.
